20273.overview:
Prepare For The Alien Attack!

Aliens are out to take over your colonies and it's up to you to stop them. You're armed with an arsenal of lasers, missiles and smart bombs, but it takes more than raw fire power to stop these guys. You've got to be quick and accurate to keep your cities from becoming alien neighborhoods. This Jaguar update of the arcade classic includes Original Missile Command, 3D Missile Command and Virtual Mission Command. Defend the cities from the relentless alien attack!

448637.overview: The original Mortal Kombat (1992) arcade game is now yours to take home on the Atari Jaguar. Pure 64-bit carnage, seven original fighters, and an evil sorcerer Shang Tsung. Play as flamin' hot ninja assassin Scorpion, Sub Zero, a ninja who's colder than ice, Hollywood movie star Johnny Cage, lightning deity Raiden, Earthrealm's protector, Sonya Blade the bleach blonde soldier, Black Dragon assassin Kano, and Liu Kang, who is half one man army, half martial artist. Only you can become the true Mortal Kombat champion by defeating the four-armed Shokan monster Goro and sorcerer Shang Tsung. Gruesome, astonishing, skin melting, flesh burning, meat ripping, bone splitting. skull crushing, blood spattering fatalities take dismemberment and mutilation to a whole new level. A mini-game where you can break sticks, stones, diamonds, and gems, only with your brute godly strength. A bone to pick with Reptile, if only you have twice the flawless victories, and so much more. Ryu, move over! Bruce Lee, watch out! There's a whole new game to play with twice the blood and guts and it's way better than the Street Fighter games. Who will be the next Mortal Kombat champion? You decide!
